pages.text: Pressure Vessels are simple fluid storage that hold an enormous amount of fluid: 200 buckets each, and 8 more per storage upgrade level. They are handy for keeping fluids in one place, such as water from your sluice for your water turbines.
pages.title: Pressure Vessel

pages.text: Vessels touching each other share their fluid, so any shape or size of them works as one huge tank. A fludd in the special slot fills up from the pressurised water inside.
